description: This file defines a KycProvider class in Dart that manages the in-memory state of KYC (Know Your Customer) data, interacts with a repository to fetch, save, and clear data, and provides notification to listeners about state changes.

classes.name: KycProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages KYC data, handles loading state, and interfaces with a repository for persistence.

methods.name: KycProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the provider with a KycRepository instance.

methods.name: KycProvider.bootstrap
methods.description: A static async method that initializes the provider, loads existing KYC data from storage, and sets the loading state.

methods.name: loading
methods.description: Getter that returns whether the provider is currently loading data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves new KYC data to the repository, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the KYC data from the repository and resets internal state.
